theorem: For a fixed finite preparation family, deterministic Blackwell quotients are exactly partitions of the minimal proportional-likelihood atoms, hence form Pi_m with Stirling rank numbers S(m,k). The same readout can have m=12 or m=1 after changing localized preparations to orbit averages. Spectral thermal preparations give m=7 because functions of A cannot split its degenerate Fourier pairs. Thus the quotient lattice is an operational property of preparation plus instrument, not an observer-independent ontology of A.
